data.notes: August 2026 is unusually strong for Las Vegas, anchored by stadium-scale rock and Latin pop shows plus Sphere and Strip residencies.

events.title: Karol G: Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour
events.summary: Karol G’s Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour comes to Allegiant Stadium. The stadium calendar lists the Las Vegas show for Friday, August 7, 2026 at 7:00 PM.

events.title: AC/DC: POWER UP Tour 2026
events.summary: AC/DC bring the POWER UP Tour to Allegiant Stadium with special guest The Pretty Reckless. The venue lists the show for Saturday, August 1, 2026 at 7:00 PM.

events.title: Backstreet Boys: Into The Millennium
events.summary: Backstreet Boys continue their Into The Millennium Sphere residency with multiple explicitly listed August 2026 dates; August 1 is one representative confirmed date. The production is built around the band’s Millennium-era catalog and Sphere visuals.

events.title: Guns N' Roses: World Tour 2026
events.summary: Guns N’ Roses bring their 2026 World Tour to Allegiant Stadium. The venue confirms the Las Vegas concert for Saturday, August 22, 2026.

events.title: Kelly Clarkson: Studio Sessions - The Las Vegas Residency
events.summary: Kelly Clarkson’s Studio Sessions residency returns to The Colosseum at Caesars Palace with August 2026 dates including August 7. The show is billed as a career-spanning live studio-style residency with her band and longtime collaborators.

events.title: Grupo Frontera: Triste Pero Bien C*brón Tour
events.venueName: Michelob ULTRA Arena at Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino
events.summary: Grupo Frontera bring their Triste Pero Bien C*brón Tour to Michelob ULTRA Arena. AXS lists the Las Vegas concert for Saturday, August 1, 2026 at 8:00 PM.

events.title: BINI: SIGNALS The BINI World Tour 2026
events.summary: Filipino pop group BINI bring the SIGNALS World Tour to PH Live at Planet Hollywood. Ticketmaster lists the Las Vegas show for Saturday, August 8, 2026 at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Boyz II Men at The Chelsea
events.venueName: The Chelsea at The Cosmopolitan of Las Vegas
events.summary: Boyz II Men return to The Chelsea at The Cosmopolitan for select August 2026 performances; August 14 is one representative confirmed date. The MGM Resorts event page lists shows on August 14, 15, 21, and 22.

events.title: Billy Idol: Hot In The City
events.venueName: BleauLive Theater at Fontainebleau Las Vegas
events.summary: Billy Idol opens his Hot In The City Las Vegas engagement at BleauLive Theater with longtime guitarist Steve Stevens in the band. Fontainebleau lists August 28, 2026 as one of five confirmed dates.

events.title: LEVI Dayclub at TAO Beach
events.summary: Afro-house/deep-house leaning dayclub date from LEVI at TAO Beach, one of the cleaner August 2026 confirmations for globally-influenced house in Las Vegas daylife.

events.title: SIDEPIECE at LIV Beach
events.summary: A confirmed Sunday dayclub date for SIDEPIECE at Fontainebleau’s LIV Beach, sitting in the tech-house/pool-party lane rather than arena programming.

events.title: BOLO at Zouk Nightclub
events.summary: San Diego DJ/producer BOLO brings a Latino-rooted high-energy house and techno sound to Zouk’s main-room residency calendar, a useful non-EDM-mainstage pick for travelers looking for Latin house/tech crossover on the Strip.

events.title: Melé - Lowkey in the Library at Marquee Nightclub
events.summary: Marquee’s smaller-room Lowkey in the Library program books UK producer/DJ Melé for a Wednesday-night house-focused party away from the obvious weekend mega-headliner lane.

events.title: Steve Aoki at OMNIA
events.summary: Steve Aoki headlines a late-night OMNIA club event. Tao Group lists the event from August 7, 2026 at 10:30 PM to August 8, 2026 at 4:00 AM.

events.title: Wax Motif at Zouk Nightclub
events.summary: Wax Motif headlines Zouk Nightclub at Resorts World Las Vegas. AXS lists the event for Friday, August 21, 2026 at 10:30 PM.

events.title: DJ Pauly D at Hakkasan Las Vegas
events.summary: DJ Pauly D headlines Hakkasan Nightclub inside MGM Grand. The venue page lists the event for Thursday, August 13, 2026 at 10:30 PM.

events.title: Drai’s After Hours: R&B Thursdays
events.summary: Drai’s confirms its August run of late-night R&B Thursdays, a recurring after-hours option for hip-hop/R&B travelers looking beyond EDM megaclub programming.
